situations.label: Half cover
situations.description: Something covers half the target: a low wall, a crate, an ally's tower shield.

situations.label: Three-quarters cover
situations.description: Only a quarter of the target shows: an arrow slit, a doorway, thick trees.

situations.label: Full cover
situations.description: Nothing of the target shows. It cannot be shot; a melee attacker reaches around the cover.

situations.label: Flanking
situations.description: Two allies stand on opposite sides of the target.

situations.label: Attacker prone
situations.description: Attacking from the ground: a weak swing, and no shot without a perk.

situations.label: Target prone
situations.description: A target on the ground is an easier shot.

situations.label: Attacker blinded
situations.description: The attacker cannot see the target. One source with an invisible target, so the two do not add. An area attack does not need to see.

situations.label: Target invisible
situations.description: The target cannot be seen. One source with a blinded attacker, so the two do not add. An area attack does not need to see.

situations.label: Shooting into melee
situations.description: An ally is engaged with the target. The Sharpshooter perk removes the penalty.
